title: Hon'Bar Loading Screen
description: Swaps out the Mojang loading screen for the Hon'bar logo!
body:
This pack is designed for use on [Hon'Bar](https://discord.gg/veU6H4YvqW), but you can use it however you like.

This resource pack replaces the default Mojang Studios loading screen with the Hon'bar logo.

You will need the Puzzle mod to see this.
